author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Support,

I can't believe that you're assuming that I ran back because I was being killed. I got hit once, so why would I run because I was being killed? How many times do I have to say that I ran back because I was close to their spawn. You are assuming the worst of people. That to me doesn't sound like a good staff member. Also you need that evidence if you want to help in showing me the reasons why I was temp-banned. You said that the guidelines say it is a temp-ban for spawn killing. Well I bet they state that they have to be warned or kicked first because how can we know that I was spawn killing. If they don't say that it means that the guidelines are screwed up.  It wasn't intentional of me to spawn kill. So if you can't see why this was a mistake I feel sorry for the rest of the Avicus community for having such bad staff.

Regards,

DaCrowMan
